verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a product-management platform, but the evidence pack never mentions a self-hosted, on-premises, or open-source deployment of Productboard. Everything documented is a cloud SaaS workspace reached through a REST API, webhooks, and a vendor-hosted MCP endpoint (https://mcp.productboard.com). API access to a hosted service is not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
